title: Source Snow rings in Caribou Race — host checkpoint
summary: The Caribou National Race weather path selects 60 original Snow ring emitters from snow.emt and renders them through one instanced draw. The Caribou Freestyle scene remains dry.
details: One hundred source birth cases compare Rust position, quantized velocity, mirror and half selection with zero differences across 24,460 EE/VU macroinstructions. Desktop and portrait source-pass captures measured 36,995 and 42,394 changed pixels; context restoration returned the Snow buffer byte-for-byte, render-only frames uploaded zero bytes, pause froze emission, and vehicle reset op23 preserved the Snow clock.

The source rings use radii 50/115/180/245 ft, 65 ft height and 4/8/16/32 divisions. The browser uses one draw and a bounded 10,800-slot allocation (508,016 GPU bytes), an implementation budget rather than a claim about original shared-bank size.
limitation: Host-only component evidence pending merge and public R2 publication. The original shared random-table cursor/order, scene-bank overwrite order, native camera lookup/rounding, PS2 render queue and physical-device behavior remain unresolved. This does not establish complete weather or game parity.
caption: Host Chromium at 390×844 portrait: Caribou Race preview with source Snow visible, the ATV and the CPU field on the HUD. Browser capture, not a physical-phone photo.
